sections.name: Path to Glory
sections.text: Here, you will find additional rules to use with a Hedonites of Slaanesh army while playing through a Path to Glory campaign. The Path to Glory content in this book is divided into two parts: the Anvil of Apotheosis and Paths for Hedonites of Slaanesh units.

sections.name: The Anvil of Apotheosis
sections.text:
You can have 1 Anvil of Apotheosis hero on your Order of Battle and/ - or army roster, unless otherwise specified in the battlepack you are using. They can be your warlord.
There are 7 steps to follow to create your hero:
1. Set a destiny point limit.
2. Fill out the starting warscroll.
3. Pick an Archetype.
4. Pick your hero’s origin and/or flaw.
5. Pick a Battle Mount.
6. Pick any Battle Mount Upgrades.
7. Pick any other upgrades.

sections.name: Step 1 - Set a Destiny Point Limit
sections.text:
The Anvil of Apotheosis uses a currency called destiny points. First, you need to set a destiny point limit. This will determine how many destiny points you have to spend on your hero, what type of hero they will be and what their battle profile points cost will be.
Pick 1 of the following:
HERO TYPE | DESTINY POINT LIMIT | BATTLE PROFILE POINTS COST
Degenerate Soul | 10 | 150
Narcissistic Reprobate | 30 | 250
Champion of Excess | 50 | 350
Over the next few steps, you will pick options for your hero. Each option has a destiny point cost, abbreviated as DP. Keep a record of the number of destiny points you have spent. You cannot exceed the limit you have set.

sections.name: Step 3 - Pick an Archetype
sections.text:
You must pick 1 of the following Archetypes for your hero:
SYBARITE LORD
0DP
Your hero has the SYBARITE keyword and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any SYBARITE units
HERALD OF THE DARK PRINCE
-2DP
Your hero has the DAEMON and WARD (6+) keywords and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON units
SYBARITE SORCERER
-4DP
Your hero has the SYBARITE and WIZARD (1) keywords and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any SYBARITE units
MASTER OF SEDUCTION
-5DP
Your hero has the DAEMON, WARD (6+) and WIZARD (1) keywords and the following regiment options:
Regiment Options | Any HEDONITES OF SLAANESH DAEMON units
SINFUL EXEMPLAR
-5DP
Your hero has the SYBARITE keyword and the following regiment options. In addition, replace their melee weapon with the following weapon:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Weapon of Seduction
Crit (2 Hits) | 5 | 3+ | 4+ | 1 | 2
Regiment Options | Any HEDONITES OF SLAANESH units

sections.name: Step 4 - Pick Your Hero's Origin And/Or Flaw
sections.text: You can pick up to 1 origin and up to 1 flaw for your hero. Each adds an ability to your hero’s warscroll. However, instead of costing destiny points, flaws give you extra destiny points to spend elsewhere.

sections.name: Origins
sections.text:
Passive
-2DP
DAEMONIC PARAMOUR
Effect: When making run rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the run roll.
Enemy Shooting Phase
-2DP
SWAGGER OF A CHAMPION
Effect: This unit can move D6" but must end that move no further from the closest visible enemy unit than it was at the start of the move. If equidistant to 2 units, pick either.
Passive
-4DP
THEATRICAL NATURE
Effect: This unit has WARD (5+) if it charged in the same turn.
Passive
-4DP
DEVOTEE OF FLESH
Effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for this unit’s attacks while it is damaged.

sections.name: Flaws
sections.text:
Passive
+2DP
MELODRAMATIC MASOCHIST
Effect: This unit cannot use the ‘Rally’ or ‘All-out Defence’ commands.
Passive
+2DP
FOREMOST AN ARTIST
Effect: Other than the Companion ability, weapon abilities for this unit’s attacks have no effect.
Passive
+4DP
JEALOUS PATRON
Effect: Subtract 1 from ward rolls for other friendly units that are visible to this unit and within its combat range.
Passive
+4DP
CREEPING ENNUI
Effect: This unit cannot be picked to be a PARAGON.

sections.name: Step 5 - Pick a Battle Mount
sections.text:
You can pick up to 1 Battle Mount for your hero.
Battle Mount
-5DP
STEED OF SLAANESH: These daemons are gifted to Slaanesh’s favoured; they move in a blur, while their tongues drip venom.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Steed’s Poisoned Tongue
Companion | 2 | 3+ | 3+ | - | 1
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 14".
Change the Health characteristic to 7.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the CAVALRY keyword.
Battle Mount
-7DP
EXALTED STEED: An Exalted Steed is an especially large and majestic daemon-mount - difficult to master, but even more potent.
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Exalted Steed’s Poisoned Tongue
Companion | 3 | 3+ | 3+ | - | 1
In addition, make the following changes to your hero’s warscroll:
Change the Move characteristic to 14".
Change the Health characteristic to 8.
Replace the INFANTRY keyword with the CAVALRY keyword.

sections.name: Step 6 - Battle Any Battle Mount Upgrades
sections.text:
If your hero has a Battle Mount, you can pick any number of Battle Mount Upgrades for them. The same upgrade cannot be picked more than once.
Upgrade | Effect
Captivating Musk
-1DP
Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll:
Passive
CAPTIVATING MUSK
Effect: Subtract 1 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.
Impossibly Fleet
-2DP
Add 2" to the Move characteristic of your hero.
Imperious Gait
-3DP
Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll:
Passive
IMPERIOUS GAIT
Effect: This unit can use the ‘Power Through’ command even if the target has a higher Health characteristic than this unit.
Above Natural Law
-3DP
Add the following ability to your hero's warscroll:
Passive
ABOVE NATURAL LAW
Effect: This unit can pass through enemy models and their combat ranges as if it had FLY.
Tailored Toxins
-3DP
Your hero’s Companion melee weapons have Anti-X (+1 Rend), where X is a faction keyword or 1 of the following keywords: INFANTRY, CAVALRY, MONSTER, WAR MACHINE, HERO, WIZARD or PRIEST.
Animal Ecstasy
-4DP
Add the following ability to your hero's warscroll:
Passive
ANIMAL ECSTASY
Effect: You can re-roll charge rolls for this unit.
Tongue-bind
-5DP
Add the following ability to your hero's warscroll:
Any Combat Phase
TONGUE-BIND
Declare: Pick an enemy non- MONSTER HERO in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, for the rest of the turn, while this unit has not used a FIGHT ability, the target has STRIKE-LAST.
Adenaline Fiend
-6DP
Add the following ability to your hero's warscroll:
Deployment Phase
ADRENALINE FIEND
Effect: This unit can use the ‘Normal Move’ ability as if it were your movement phase.

sections.text:
Pick any number of other upgrades for your hero. The same upgrade cannot be picked more than once.

Slickblade Glaive
-4DP
Add the following weapon to your hero’s warscroll:
MELEE WEAPONS | Atk | Hit | Wnd | Rnd | Dmg
Slickblade Glaive

Sage of Sin
-6DP
WIZARD only. Add the following ability to your hero’s warscroll:
Passive
SAGE OF SIN
Effect: Add 1 to casting rolls and banishment rolls for this unit.

sections.name: Path of The Princeling
sections.text:
(HEDONITES OF SLAANESH HERO only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, Reaction: You declared a SPELL, UNBIND or BANISH ability for this unit
TANTALISING LORE
Effect: You can roll an additional dice and add it to that casting roll, unbinding roll or banishment roll.
Passive
ARROGANT DISREGARD
Effect: This unit can use CHARGE and SHOOT abilities even if it used a RETREAT ability in the same turn. In addition, no mortal damage is inflicted on this unit by RETREAT abilities.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
SUPREME MASOCHIST
Effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to this unit in each phase.
Passive
MIST-WREATHED
Effect: While this unit is contesting an objective, it is not visible to enemy units that are not in combat with it.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Enemy Shooting Phase
SEDUCTIVE WORDS
Declare: If this unit is not in combat, pick the closest visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target.
Effect: Inflict D6 mortal damage on the target.
Once Per Battle, End of Any Turn
BLISSFUL PRESENCE
Effect: Heal (D6) each visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of this unit.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
VESSEL OF THE LORDS
Effect: Heal (X) this unit, where X is the number of damage points allocated to this unit. For the rest of the turn, add 1 to hit rolls and wound rolls for this unit’s attacks, and add 1 to save rolls for this unit. At the start of the next turn, this unit is automatically destroyed.
Passive
ARCH-LIBERTINE
Effect: Subtract 1 from the Damage characteristic of weapons used by enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

sections.name: Path of The Hedonist
sections.text:
(non- HERO HEDONITES OF SLAANESH unit only)
ASPIRING: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Enemy Hero Phase
PROVOCATEURS
Declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: Roll a dice. On a 4+, for the rest of the turn, while the target is in combat with this unit, when the target uses an ATTACK ability, models in the target unit that are in combat with this unit must pick this unit to be the target of their attacks.
Passive
AN ENDLESS FESTIVAL
Effect: Each time an enemy unit within 12" of this unit uses an ability that results in any slain models being returned to it, after that ability has been resolved, return 1 slain model to this unit.
ELITE: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Once Per Turn (Army), Any Charge Phase
FRANTIC OFFENSIVE
Effect: For the rest of the phase, when making charge rolls for this unit, add 1 to the number of dice rolled, to a maximum of 3, then remove 1 dice of your choice and use the remaining dice as the charge roll.
Once Per Turn (Army), Any Combat Phase
FRESH PLEASURES
Effect: If this unit did not charge this turn and is in combat, it can move D6". It can pass through the combat ranges of enemy units and can end that move in combat.
MIGHTY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Reaction: Opponent declared a MOVE ability for a unit in 1 combat with this unit
ETERNAL DANCE
Effect: After that MOVE ability has been resolved, this unit can move 2D6" but must end that move in combat with that enemy unit.
Passive
MOCKING DODGE
Effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target this unit.
LEGENDARY: When a unit on this Path gains this rank, pick 1 of the following abilities for them:
Passive
KNIGHTS OF EXCESS
Effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of this unit’s melee weapons.
Once Per Battle, Any Hero Phase
DAEMONIC VISAGES
Declare: Pick a visible enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
Effect: For the rest of the turn, the target cannot use a CORE ability unless your opponent spends 1 command point to use it as if it were a command.
